name: flickies
description: Self-hosted video toolkit — lipsync, face restore, and ffmpeg ops (trim, concat, transcode, scale) via REST and MCP

flickies_url.title: flickies URL
flickies_url.description: Base URL of your running flickies server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (sets FLICKIES_URL).

flickies_auth_token.title: flickies auth token
flickies_auth_token.description: Bearer token. Only needed if the server was started with FLICKIES_AUTH_TOKEN set.
